author: Nintendo of America
description:
A free Prologue Demo for Metaphor: ReFantazio is available now on Nintendo Switch 2! Save data from the demo will carry over to the full game when it releases on November 12, 2026: https://ninten.do/6003asLyP

Enter the royal tournament to fight for the throne. Control your destiny, face your fears, and awaken magical “Archetype” powers that lie dormant in your heart. Team up with a compelling cast of characters and embark on an immersive journey that promises hours of captivating exploration, dynamic turn-based with a blend of real-time combat, and exhilarating discovery. 

#MetaphorReFantazio

description:
Play NBA 2K27 Season 2, now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6004avurg
 
NBA 2K27 Season 2 is headlined by Tyrese Haliburton and Caitlin Clark, two of the biggest names in Indiana basketball. Every game, every possession, every moment is an opportunity to overcome the opposition and prove they have what it takes to lead their teams to glory.  
 
Perfect your build, make a name for yourself in MyCAREER, ball out in The City, and stack Ws on your way to Level 40, earning all-new rewards for your MyPLAYER and your MyTEAM, so you can make an impression as soon as you get on the floor.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
Nintendo Switch Sports Resort launches October 22, 2026, exclusively on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Pre-orders are available now: https://ninten.do/6000avXZQ

Welcome to Spocco Resort! Dive into 12 sports with intuitive motion controls that make it easy for anyone to pick up. Enjoy classic sports including Archery, Basketball, Boxing, and Tennis, along with new ones like Skateboarding and Thumb Wrestling. 

Play casually with friends, on your own, or turn up the heat in Island Crown mode or the Pro League! From fast-paced matches to secret island surprises, there are plenty of ways to play, connect, and explore.
